lessvillagerchatter.config.title: Less Villager Chatter
lessvillagerchatter.config.interval.tool: Average time between idle "hmm" sounds of villagers (left) and the wandering trader (right). Vanilla is about 6 s.
lessvillagerchatter.config.volume.toolti: Volume of all villager / wandering trader sounds. In worlds you host, everyone hears this. On a server, the server's own setting applies unless "Use my volume" is on.
lessvillagerchatter.config.variation.too: Each silence after a "hmm" is randomly this much shorter or longer. The average stays the same.
Villagers loaded together start at random points of their cycle, so they don't all "hmm" at once. Applies to villagers loaded after the change.
lessvillagerchatter.config.own_volume: Use my volume on every server
lessvillagerchatter.config.own_volume.to: ON: you hear villagers and traders at the volumes above on any server, even one without this mod. OFF: you hear the volume the server sends.
lessvillagerchatter.config.note: Changes apply right away. Hover over a setting for details.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lessvilla: Villagers and wandering traders make their idle "hmm" sound less often, and optionally quieter. Server-side: players can join with a vanilla client.
